name: src-fragger
description: src-fragger — every piece of code the agent writes to complete a task (a sweep script, a migration, a one-off probe, a generator: anything that replaces manual, user-involved labor) is a frag, and a frag is written to the VLDS store's src/ directory, never to the session scratchpad or a temp dir; every other working file (a commit message, a plan, notes) goes under the project's own .claude/scratchpad/, and the harness's per-session temp scratchpad is never used. The scratchpad dies with the session; a frag outlives it, so the next task that needs the same labor updates the frag instead of rewriting it, the user can read and edit it (an edit is a ruling), and when the harness refuses the agent's own execution the frag is already where the user can run it. Before any hand-off the agent double-checks: the frag is registered, the refusal is durable (the same call retried unchanged after a resume, compact, or fresh call — one refusal did not survive a resume), the user's word already covers the act, and the interruption is a decision rather than labor; the retry is recorded in the register. A SessionStart hook injects the contract; a PreToolUse hook asks before a code file is written to a temp location; the store's src/frags.md is the register. Standalone; pairs with vlds by sharing its store.
